data.description: You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams. The team ships weekly and keeps a short list of priorities that everyone can read. You will write clear requirements, review designs with engineers and check the result against the goal.
data.key_responsibilities:
• You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams.

data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
• Most of the work is turning vague requests into scoped, testable changes.
  • We value plain writing, steady delivery and a habit of asking why before asking how.
  • You will partner with support, finance and engineering leads to agree what ships next.
